comment: RenderWare: calls cb(material, data) for each material of the geometry (list at +0x20, count +0x24)

name: RpMaterialSetTexture
comment: RenderWare: material->texture = tex (reference count +0x54 + 1, the old one released with Tex_Release)

name: RtAnimAnimationStreamRead
comment: RenderWare: reads an animation (chunk 0x1B); Pack_Load calls it for chunk type 0x1B

name: RwStreamReadChunkHeaderInfo
comment: RenderWare: reads a 12-byte chunk header {type, size, library id} and unpacks the version (0x1C02000A -> 0x37002); Pack_Load uses it to walk an entry

name: RwTextureStreamRead
comment: RenderWare: reads a texture chunk (0x06); Pack_Load calls it for chunk type 6

name: RwTexDictionaryStreamRead
comment: RenderWare: reads a texture dictionary (chunk 0x16, PS2 native textures 0x15 inside); Pack_Load calls it for chunk type 0x16

name: RwImageStreamRead
comment: RenderWare: reads an image (chunk 0x18); Pack_Load then makes a texture of it named after the next key in request->+4

name: Fighter_AttachPart
comment: (item, fighter, part slot, clump, ?) puts an outfit item's clump on the fighter: category 0 (body) becomes the fighter's main clump with the skeleton (HAnim hierarchy); any other item is hung on body skeleton node ItemDef.attach_node (part slot +0x5F0 = hierarchy nodeInfo[node].frame); category 7 (left shoe) also calls 0x002FA9F0
type: void (int item, Fighter *f, int slot, void *clump, int a5)

name: g_ArchiveTexNames
comment: per XAF archive id, a pointer to its texture name table {u32 ?, char *name} per entry: DATA, FSTAGE?, CDATA all point at g_TexNames 0x0059AE30; GRAPH at 0x005AB0D0

name: g_TexNames
comment: {u32 ?, char *name} per DATA.XAF entry (8276): the texture cache key; outfit placeholders are names like LEG_A01AAA, real textures LEG_B01AAA (docs/FORMATS.md)

name: Lzss_Decode
comment: (src, dst, size) LZSS of STAGE.XAF pack items (4 KB window from 0xFEE, flag bit 1 = literal, match {12-bit offset, 4-bit length + 3}); docs/ANIMATION.md

name: AnimPack_OpenItem
comment: (pack, index, stream desc) unpacks item index of a STAGE.XAF pack (u32 count, u32 {bits 28-31 compression 0/8, bits 0-27 offset}[]) into a 128 KB buffer and opens it as a memory stream

name: RwStreamFindChunk
comment: RenderWare: skips chunks until type (here 0x1B) and checks the library version (0x35000-0x37002)

name: RtAnimRegisterInterpolationScheme
comment: RenderWare: adds an RtAnimInterpolatorInfo (0x30 bytes) to g_RtAnimInterpInfo

name: RpHAnimCmpKeyInterpolate
comment: RenderWare compressed keyframes (type 2): (time, out, key1, key2, custom data) slerp of the float16 quaternions, lerp of translation * scale + offset
type: void (float t, void *out, void *k1, void *k2, float *custom)

name: RpHAnimCmpKeyMulRecip
comment: RenderWare compressed keyframes: key1 = key1 * inverse(key2) (float16 in and out)

name: RwFloat16Compress
comment: float -> RenderWare 16-bit float (sign, 4-bit exponent - 112, 11-bit mantissa)

name: RpHAnimCmpKeyStreamRead
comment: RenderWare compressed keyframes: reads n x {f32 time, u16 q[4], u16 t[3], s32 previous key byte offset / 24} then the 24-byte custom data {offset xyz, scale xyz}

name: g_RtAnimInterpInfo
comment: RenderWare registered interpolators, 0x30 bytes each {type, key size in memory, key size, apply, blend, interpolate, add, mulrecip, stream read, stream write, stream size, custom data size}; type 2 (compressed) is the only one the animations use

name: Action_Timeline
comment: runs the action's second stream (fighter +0x3FD8) each frame after Action_Step: waits on the motion frame (+0x2D4), attack windows, combo and cancel points, effects, flags (docs/ANIMATION.md, "Frame data")

name: Action_TryCombo
comment: at a cancel point (timeline op 0x16): matches the last input (+0x4510) against the style's command list and starts the follow-up; +0x450C combo count +1

name: Fighter_ReturnControl
comment: state = 1, sets CONTROL (flags4388 bit 0), clears the attack flags and the combo count (timeline op 0x3C's release frame)

name: Fighter_NewAttackId
comment: +0x44E6 += 1: a new swing, so the same attack can hit again (timeline ops 0x30 and 0x2D HIT)

name: Fighter_AttackCollide
comment: (fighter, other) sends the attack spheres (g_AttackSpheres, radius x 2) whose bit is in +0x44F0, only while +0x44F4 <= motion frame (+0x2D4) <= +0x44F6; damage from g_ActionHits[+0x4348][+0x4570]

name: Fighter_UpdateMotion
comment: advances the motion by frame time x speed (+0x3FE8, x1.2 when 0x0060C960 bit 0), blends from the previous motion over +0x3FA8 seconds, copies bone positions to +0x35C

name: Fighter_TaskWalk
comment: walk state: starts Fighter_RemapAction(2) (M body: action 2, anim 5)

name: Fighter_TaskAction
comment: per-frame action state: tired, and the op 0x3C frames (+0x43AA guard bit, +0x43A8 Fighter_ReturnControl)

name: Pad_ReadCommand
comment: turns the pad into an input code and stores it at fighter +0x4510; inputs while the fighter is busy (state & 6) count up +0x450D

name: g_BodySpheres
comment: collision spheres per body part, 0x14 bytes {s8 bone, f32 offset[3], f32 radius}, ends bone -1 (9 parts); g_SphereTables[0]

name: g_AttackSpheres
comment: attack spheres, same format (12 parts: 0/1 bones 14/19, 2/3 bones 4/7, 4/5 bones 13/18, 6/7 bones 3/6, 8/9 bones 11/16, 10 bone 10, 11 bone 1); bit n of timeline op 0x24 = part n

name: g_HurtSpheres
comment: 18 spheres over the whole body, same format; g_SphereTables[2]

name: g_SphereTables
comment: {g_BodySpheres, g_AttackSpheres, g_HurtSpheres}

name: g_AreaDefs
comment: 57 x 0x104-byte area definitions, index = area id (Area_Current): name text, sound banks, music, lights, battle spots, collision material kinds (docs/STAGES.md)

name: Area_Def
comment: (area) -> &g_AreaDefs[area]

name: Area_DefFlag101
comment: (area) -> AreaDef +0x101 (u8, meaning open)

name: Area_DefFlag100
comment: (area) -> AreaDef +0x100 (u8); the door collision test skips a door whose destination area has this != 1 (when asked to)

name: Area_CurrentDef10
comment: -> AreaDef +0x10 (float, 50 subway / 80 downtown) of the current area; used by 0x00307B50

name: Area_MaterialKind
comment: (area, collision material, which) -> AreaDef +0xC4[material] (which 0) or +0xE8[material] (which 1) & 0x1F; which 1 = the wall kind of the wall-collision material a fighter touches (fighter +0x34A)
type: u16 (int area, int material, int which)

name: Area_BattleSpotCount
comment: (area) -> number of battle spots (AreaDef +0x14 list), 0 if none

name: Area_PickBattleSpot
comment: (mode, area, pos) -> s16[4] {x, y, z, angle} in tenths: mode < 0 g_BattleSpotDefault[area], > 0 spot 0 (story fights), 0 the spot nearest pos among spots 1..n-1 (special cases for areas 0x13, 0x1E, 0x26)

name: Battle_PlaceFighters
comment: at a field fight start: puts the player and the opponent at Area_PickBattleSpot's spot (opponent facing back, 180 degrees), or at g_FixedBattlePos[area] when the area has no spots; spot 0 for (area, story stage) pairs 0x36/11, 0x21/10, 0x25/10, 0x2D/9, 0xE/8, 5/7, 0x1A/6, 0x19/4, 0x33/3, 0xD/1

name: g_FixedBattlePos
comment: u32 per area: pointer to two fighter positions {float x, y, z, angle} x 2, used by Battle_PlaceFighters when the area has no battle spots

name: g_BattleSpotDefault
comment: s16[4] per area {x, y, z, angle} in tenths: Area_PickBattleSpot mode -1

name: g_AreaSpawnPoints
comment: Area_ChangeTo's arrival points {float x, y, z, 0}: 0x509700 default, then 0x509710 area 0x2F, 0x509720 0x19, 0x509730 0x2A, 0x509740 0xC, 0x509750 0x15, 0x509760 0xF, 0x509770 7, 0x509780 0x1D, 0x509790/0x5097A0 area 1, 0x5097B0/0x5097C0 area 0x1A

name: Area_LoadStage
comment: (pack, ?, area state) Area_Load step 3: Stage_Parse the FSTAGE.XAF pack into the staging copy 0x00713B20, then copy 0x9C10 bytes to the area state (DAT_005FFDE0) and Stage_SetCurrent(+0x6230)

name: Stage_Parse
comment: (stage, pack, area) one section per call: 0 textures, 1 RpWorld (stage +0x18), 2-4 walls/camera/floor collision clumps (+0x44..+0x4C, atomics +0x50.., bounding boxes), 5+6 doors clump and its animation (Doors_Load), 7 props (Stage_LoadProps), 8 PB placements (Stage_PlacePB, Stage_PlaceExtra, Stage_PlaceObjects), 9 up to 16 animations; returns 1 when done

name: Stage_Clear
comment: (stage) clears the 0x39C0-byte stage struct and its collision (+0x40) and props (+0x450) parts

name: Stage_SetCurrent
comment: (stage) makes it the current stage (0x005FED8C) and its +0x40 the current collision (Collision_SetCurrent)

name: Collision_SetCurrent
comment: (collision) sets 0x005FED80, returns the old one

name: Area_Collision
comment: -> the current area's collision (area state +0x6270 = stage +0x40): +0x04/+0x08/+0x0C walls, camera, floor clumps, +0x10.. their atomics, +0x70 door count, +0x80 doors (0x60 bytes each)

name: Collision_Query
comment: (collision, mesh 0 walls / 1 camera / 2 floor, query, result 0x40 bytes, flags) flags 1 test that mesh's atomic, 2 the props (+0x3F0 list), 4 the doors (zone first, then panel), 8 skip doors whose destination has Area_DefFlag100 != 1
type: int (void *coll, int mesh, void *query, float *result, u32 flags)

name: Collision_FloorHeight
comment: (collision, pos, result) vertical ray through the floor mesh between its bounding-box min and max y at pos x, z; result +4.. = the hit point (y = floor height)

name: Collision_SphereWalls
comment: (radius, collision, pos, result, flags) sphere at pos against the wall mesh (and doors with flag 4); result +4.. pushed-out position, +0x10.. normal, hit type 1 world (material via Area_MaterialKind) or 2 object; fighters use radius 5.5 (Fighter wall slam, action 0x2ED), 11, 15, 40; off while debug switch 5 and L1+R1+L2+... are held
type: int (float radius, void *coll, float *pos, float *result, u32 flags)

name: Collision_Segment
comment: (collision, from, to, result, flags) segment against the camera mesh; used by the camera (0x00376AF0, 0x0037A400) with 0x0076B4A8 / 0x0076B4B8
type: int (void *coll, float *from, float *to, float *result, u32 flags)

name: Collision_FloorList
comment: (collision, pos, ?, out) every floor under pos x, z: out {u32 count, then 0x40-byte hits with y at +8}; FloorList_Pick picks one

name: FloorList_Pick
comment: (y, tolerance, list) the highest floor hit at or below y + tolerance (callers use 5.0)

name: Doors_Load
comment: (collision + 0x70, doors clump, doors animation) reads the doors clump (section 5) and its HAnim animation (section 6) and collects up to 9 doors with Doors_CollectAtomic

name: Doors_CollectAtomic
comment: RpClumpForAllAtomics callback: the atomic on a frame under the hierarchy root is a door's zone (+0), the one on its child frame the panel (+4); the frame's BONETAG goes to +0x54 (destination area; negative tags -(area x 10 + entrance) are split into +0x54 area, +0x58 entrance), raw tag at +0x56

name: Door_State
comment: (door index) looks the door's raw tag up in g_AreaDoorFlags: story flag first_flag + index set -> 0 (and +0x50 = 0x00351280(flag)); else 0 if the destination is in the area's allowed list (or the special 0x30/0x33 pair), else 1. Meaning of 0/1 (locked/open) not confirmed

name: g_AreaDoorFlags
comment: 0x14 bytes per area: {+0 u8 *destinations whose doors are disabled (0x00351810), +4 u8 *allowed destinations (count, ids), +8 s16 first story flag, +0xA s16 count, +0xC s16 *raw door tags, +0x10 u32 *per-door table (0x003513F0; open)}; read by Door_State and Door_Locked (docs/STAGES.md, "Doors in use")

name: Door_FindArrival
comment: (doors = collision +0x70, previous area, entrance) -> the destination's door record the player arrives at: entrance >= 1 = record entrance-1, else the door whose destination is the previous area (docs/STAGES.md)

name: Door_ArrivalPoint
comment: (?, pos out, angle out) the arrival point (door record +0x40, the panel's child frame LTM position) and facing atan2(at.x, at.z) in degrees; no door: door 0; story flag 998 moves it 70 units along -at

name: Door_Locked
comment: (door record) its raw tag (+0x56) in g_AreaDoorFlags' tag list -> story flag first_flag + index (area 0x13 tag -462: flag 931); flag set -> 1 and +0x50 = Door_LockText(flag); flag clear -> 0; tag not listed -> -1

name: Door_LockText
comment: (story flag) -> the locked-door message text id (30450-30465: It's locked., You can't get any further., ...)

name: Door_ZoneTest
comment: (radius, test panels, doors, pos) vertical ray from 10 above to 25 below the floor point under pos against each door's zone (then panel) atomic -> the door record hit or 0; stores the door index at +0x5C
type: void *(float radius, int panels, int *doors, float *pos)

name: Door_Destination
comment: (pos, door index out, entrance out) Door_ZoneTest(radius 5) on the current area's doors -> the destination area (+0x54), or 0 when locked (Door_Locked 1) or the area bit is clear (Area_DoorOpen); 0x30 -> 0x33 never

name: Battle_EscapeDoor
comment: per frame in a battle after Battle_RequestEscape: the player on a door zone facing it (within 90 degrees of the zone frame's atan2(at.x, at.z) + 180) -> Door_Destination, blinking icon (texture 0x3DD), then the escape through the door (docs/CONTROLS.md)

name: Area_SetTarget
comment: (area, entrance) stores the area change target (0x006CBB04 area, 0x006CBB08 entrance) and the previous area (0x006CBB00)

name: Area_DoorOpen
comment: (area) -> area when its bit is set in the per-area bit set at gp-0x4F08 (0x005FFAF8 region; probably areas opened by the story), else 0

name: Fighter_HazardWall
comment: (fighter) a fighter touching a hazard wall kind (+0x34A = 9, 11, 28, 29; only objects have them) takes damage and starts action 0x6B4 / 0x6D6 / 0x6D5 with an effect

name: Doors_DisableDests
comment: (doors) clears the usable byte of the doors whose destination is in the current area's g_AreaDoorFlags +0 list

name: Door_ArrivalIndex
comment: -> the index of the door the player arrives at (same rule as Door_FindArrival)

name: Doors_CopyArrival
comment: (?, frame) while a door panel is collected: copies the panel's child frame LTM (the arrival marker) into the door record +0x10

name: g_AreaObjects
comment: 0x28 bytes per area: {s16 prop count, s16 extra count, fn init, 0x28-byte prop descriptors, fn extra placements, s8 prop ids x 4, u32 count, 0x24-byte object records placed per story stage (type 1 prop, 2 special, 3 weapon, 4 item)} (docs/STAGES.md)

name: Stage_LoadProps
comment: (props, section 7, area, world) reads the area's prop clumps into 0x48-byte slots (+0x28 clump) and copies g_AreaObjects descriptors into them

name: Stage_PlacePB
comment: (props, section 8) the 'PB' placements: s16 count, then {s32 prop (1-based), float x, y, z, quaternion x, y, z, w}

name: Stage_PlaceExtra
comment: (props) places the props listed by g_AreaObjects +0xC's function: s16[8] {prop, x, y, z, rot x, y, z} in tenths

name: Stage_PlaceObjects
comment: (type mask, props) places g_AreaObjects' records present in the current story stage (index = stage - 1, 11 in special mode), unless the record's story flag (6000-7499) is set: 4 items (0x002FF010 at floor height), 3 weapons (0x002FF390), 2 special (table 0x005B5840), 1 props

name: Stage_LoadCommon
comment: loads FSTAGE.XAF entry 56 (shared textures and models) once into 0x0071D830; Area_Load step 0

name: Xaf_ReadEntry
comment: (archive, entry, callback, arg, flags, buffer) reads a whole XAF entry into memory (buffer or a new 64-aligned allocation) in the background; returns the 0x24-byte request {file, size, ?, data, archive, entry, flags, callback, arg}
type: void *(int archive, int entry, void *cb, void *arg, u32 flags, void *buf)

name: RpWorldStreamRead
comment: RenderWare: reads a world (chunk 0x0B: struct, material list, plane sectors 0x0A and atomic sectors 0x09); Stage_Parse section 1

name: g_ReactionSets
comment: hit reaction sets used by Combat_TakeHit: [0] 0x5161C0 normal, [1] 0x516300 heavy (low HP, counter hit, held); fighter +0x4554 picks; each = 0x16 kinds -> 4 x {s16 action, s16 angle} (behind, front, left, right); [2] 0x5163A0 / [3] 0x5163B0 are the wall-hit rows (kind 0xC: above / at most half HP; Combat_TakeHit uses &[2] as a row list); docs/ANIMATION.md "Hit reactions"

name: g_KnockdownReactions
comment: Combat_TakeHit's rows for a knockdown hit (reaction 0x20) or a KO: [0] knocked down 649 behind / 650 front / 651 / 652, [1] KO 5 / 680 / 681 / 682, [2] KO while lying 230 (face up) / 231 (face down); each 4 x {s16 action, s16 angle}

name: g_ReactionSet0
comment: normal hit reactions: 0x16 pointers (one per reaction kind) to 4 x {s16 action, s16 angle}; kind 0 front = action 703

name: g_ReactionSet1
comment: heavier hit reactions (set 1), same layout as g_ReactionSet0; kind 0 front = action 643

name: g_HitSituationSet
comment: reaction set per hit situation, returned by Combat_SituationFactor: normal 0, HP<1000 1, HP<300 1, counter 1, reeling 0, held 1

name: g_WalkModes
comment: walk task (0x30CA90) locomotion modes: 14 rows of 6 pointers, [mode*6+i] = s16 actions for 8 directions, [mode*6+3+i] = f32 speeds (units per frame); i probably body size

name: Pad_Update
comment: (frame time) reads ports 0-1 every frame: buttons through Pad_RemapButtons, auto-repeat, hold times, sticks with a half-radius rescaled dead zone, into g_Pad1 / pad 2 (docs/CONTROLS.md)

name: Pad_PortSetup
comment: (port) libpad connection state machine (analog mode lock, actuator align); 0 while the pad isn't ready

name: Pad_Vibrate
comment: (seconds, port, motor 0 small / 1 large, strength) starts a rumble if VIBRATION is on for the port (g_SystemData +7)
type: void (float seconds, int port, int motor, int strength)

name: Pad_VibrateStop
comment: (port) stops the port's rumble on the next Pad_UpdateVibration

name: Pad_UpdateVibration
comment: counts the rumbles down and sends scePadSetActDirect

name: g_PadVibration
comment: per-port rumble state: +0 u8 flags[2] (1 on, 2 start, 4 stop), +2 u8 motor[2], +4 u8 strength[2], +8 f32 time[2]

name: Fighter_Vibrate
comment: (fighter, kind 0-2) rumbles a player fighter's pad: small motor on + large motor g_VibrationStrength[kind] for g_VibrationTime[kind] s; kind 0 on every landed hit (both sides), 1 wall/hazard hit, 2 timeline op 0x50 and others

name: g_VibrationStrength
comment: large motor strength per Fighter_Vibrate kind {64, 128, 255}

name: g_VibrationTime
comment: rumble length in seconds per Fighter_Vibrate kind {0.05, 0.08, 0.09}

name: Pad_BuildButtonJobs
comment: fills g_PadJobBits for both ports from the TYPE setting (g_SystemData +5) and the fixed shoulder buttons at 0x005D04A0

name: g_PadJobBits
comment: pad bit of each button job per port ([job][port]): 0 L1 run, 1 R2 item, 2 L2 item, 3 special, 4 special, 5 R1, 6 R3 taunt, 7 guard, 8 R1 grab, 9 kick, 10 punch (docs/CONTROLS.md)

name: g_PadLayoutJP
comment: TYPE -> g_PadLayouts row with the Japanese language {3, 0, 4, 1, 2, 5}

name: g_FighterPads
comment: 0x80-byte pad per controller slot (fighter +0x17), Pad layout: left stick folded into d-pad bits (8 sectors), right stick bits 0x100000-0x800000

name: Fighter_Pad
comment: (fighter) -> its controller slot's pad in g_FighterPads

name: Fighter_ReadPad
comment: (slot, pad) copies a pad into g_FighterPads[slot], turning the sticks into direction bits

name: Fighter_MaskPad
comment: (slot, mode) 0 clears the fighter pad; 1 (message up) keeps only L1, special, R3, d-pad; 2 (field, no battle) clears R1, guard, special

name: AI_MakePad
comment: (ai, pad) turns a CPU fighter's request (abstract bits 0x80 punch, 0x200 kick, 0x100 guard, 0x40 special, 0x1000 R1, 0x800 L2, 0x2000 R2, 0x8000 R3) into its slot's pad bits; L1 to circle the target

name: Battle_RequestEscape
comment: (fighter) L1 + R1 in a battle: if the side may run and the target isn't a boss, sets g_Battle +0xA0 (+ side * 12); 0x002E2930 then needs a door zone (docs/CONTROLS.md)

name: Battle_RequestSelect
comment: (fighter) SELECT pressed in a battle while free: sets g_Battle +0xCC = 1, +0xD0 = fighter; meaning not traced

name: Text_SetString
comment: (box, UTF-8 text) Text_Encode + Text_SetCodes with the Latin glyph table; docs/HUD.md, "The text font"

name: Text_SetCodes
comment: (box, codes, glyph table, tex w, tex h) copies the font codes into the box and lays them out (Text_Layout)
type: int (int box, u16 *codes, u16 *glyphs, int tex_w, int tex_h)

name: Text_Layout
comment: (box, codes, glyph table, tex w, tex h) one quad per glyph: table per code range (Latin, kanji 1-4, icons page 5, crime icons page 6), advance w x 0.95, icon y nudges
type: int (int box, u16 *codes, u16 *glyphs, int tex_w, int tex_h)

name: Text_GlyphQuad
comment: (box, quad, raster, uv, char index) glyph colour g_TextPalette[colour byte] or the box colour when 0; position, scale, rotation, y squeeze (y - 16) x 0.4667
type: void (int box, float *quad, void *raster, int uv, int index)

name: Font_SetPages
comment: (page 0..4 rasters) g_FontPages[0..4]

name: Font_SetIconPage
comment: (raster) g_FontPages[5] = BUTTON (GRAPH 32)

name: Font_Load
comment: requests GRAPH 374 (UNICODEFONT) and, for Japanese, 375-378 (kanji pages); calls Font_SetPages

name: Font_LoadCrimeIcons
comment: (collect) GRAPH 305 MURDER_01 for the ⑰ ⑱ glyphs (page 6)

name: g_FontPages
comment: 7 rasters: 0 UNICODEFONT, 1-4 kanji (or page 0 again), 5 BUTTON icons, 6 MURDER_01

name: g_TextBoxes
comment: text box records, 0x308 bytes, index 1-127: +0x08 centring flags, +0x0C/+0x10 position, +0x20/+0x24 scale, +0x28 rotation, +0x34 colour, +0x88 per-character colour bytes; Text_Encode's box

name: g_FontGlyphs
comment: text font page 0 (UNICODEFONT 512x512): 520 x {u16 code, u, v, w, h}, code = Unicode, 0-terminated

name: g_FontKanji1
comment: font page 1 glyphs (codes 0x4E00-0x64FE), same records

name: g_FontKanji2
comment: font page 2 glyphs (0x6500-0x7E39)

name: g_FontKanji3
comment: font page 3 glyphs (0x7E3A-0x9B2E)

name: g_FontKanji4
comment: font page 4 glyphs (0x9B2F-0x9FA0)

name: g_FontCrimeGlyphs
comment: page 6 (MURDER_01): ⑰ ⑱

name: g_FontIconGlyphs
comment: page 5 (BUTTON 256x128): 25 button / stick / d-pad icons (docs/HUD.md)

name: g_TextPalette
comment: RGBA per @N / $N colour (1 white, 2 red, 3 green, 4 blue, 5 light red, 6 yellow, 7 pink, 8 mint, 9 invisible)

name: Tex_FindLoaded
comment: (name) a texture of g_HudTexGroups by name, else 0

name: g_HudTexGroups
comment: 5 groups x 4 loaded HUD textures (FONT_TEX_02/03 ...), searched by Tex_FindLoaded; g_HudSprites use (group, index)

name: Hud_LoadTextures
comment: requests the field/battle HUD textures into g_HudTex: GD_HPG_01/02, MAP_BG (language), MAP_MASK, MAP_PARTS01/02, SYSFONT02, GD_NGI_00, CURSOR, VS_PARTS_02 (language)

name: Hud_TexturesReady
comment: collects the g_HudTex loads; 1 when all 10 are in

name: g_HudTex
comment: 10 HUD textures (Hud_LoadTextures order); [0] GD_HPG_01 frame, [1] GD_HPG_02 fill, [6] SYSFONT02

name: Battle_Start
comment: allocates g_Battle (0x14C), starts Battle_Update as a task, inits the Pride gauge (PrideGauge_Init, PrideGauge_Reset per side) and the 17 battle texts (0x005990C0)

name: Hud_BattleUpdate
comment: per battle frame, both sides: HpBar_SyncMax, HpBar_TrackHP, HpBar_Drain, HpBar_BuildQuads, HpBar_PlaceNames; Pride gauge ratios + PrideGauge_Update

name: Hud_FieldUpdate
comment: the same HP bar steps outside a battle, then the map HUD

name: HpBar_Draw
comment: draws each side's bars (4 layers x 3 quads per member) with g_HudTex[0]/[1]

name: HpBar_SyncMax
comment: (side) resets a member's bar when its max HP changed

name: HpBar_TrackHP
comment: (side) on an HP change: last damage, trail-to-drain += damage, HP = new

name: HpBar_Drain
comment: (side) trail -= max(1, (trail - HP) / 60) per frame while damage is left; HP and trail x 128 / max

name: HpBar_PlaceNames
comment: (side) positions and colours the member name strings

name: HpBar_BuildQuads
comment: (side) low-HP pulse colour (0x00732250), then HpBar_MemberQuads per member and layer

name: HpBar_MemberQuads
comment: (side, member, layer) picks max / trail / HP for the member, then HpBar_LayerQuads
type: void (int side, int member, int layer)

name: HpBar_LayerQuads
comment: (max, trail, HP, side, member, layer) the 3 quads (cap, stretched middle, cap) of one layer: length 1.4 x value x 0.018, colours, side 1 mirrored (docs/HUD.md)
type: void (float max, float trail, float hp, int side, int member, int layer)

name: HpBar_SetPrideOffset
comment: (pixels) moves party members' bars down while the Pride gauge shows (gp-0x4D18)

name: g_HpBars
comment: 2 sides x 3 members x 0x28: max, trail, HP, last damage, HP before, trail left, HP x128/max, trail x128/max

name: g_HpBarPulse
comment: low-HP pulse base colours (255 180 50), 4 vertices

name: g_HpBarLayerOrder
comment: draw priority per layer: 1200 frame, 1050 trail, 1100 HP, 1000 back

name: g_HpBarNamePos
comment: name x, y per side and member (46, 75/105/133; side 1 489.6 + 104)

name: g_HpBarRowY
comment: bar y per member before + 40: 47, 81, 109

name: PrideGauge_Init
comment: finds FONT_TEX_02/03 (language suffix) by name, resets both sides

name: PrideGauge_Build
comment: (side) creates the 6 sprites (lighter, cap, fuse, fuse end, two flame sprites) and side 1's NEGOTIATION text

name: PrideGauge_Side
comment: (side) state machine: build, slide in, live (flames, side 1 NEGOTIATION OK! when empty), slide out, free

name: PrideGauge_Flames
comment: (side) flame frame cycle ((1 - ratio) x 0.05 + 0.05 s) and scale (ratio x 1.3, ratio x 1.8)

name: PrideGauge_Update
comment: both sides' PrideGauge_Side; frees the textures when both are done

name: PrideGauge_SetRatio
comment: (ratio, side) target ratio while live

name: PrideGauge_Reset
comment: (ratio, side) current = target = ratio

name: g_PrideGauge
comment: 2 sides x 0x4C: slide timer, 6 sprite handles, state +0x1C, text state +0x20, flame frame +0x28, ratio +0x3C..

name: g_PrideGaugeLayout
comment: per side 0x14: x, y, then offsets of cap, fuse, fuse end, flames (s16)

name: g_PrideFlameFrames
comment: 8 x {u, v} of the flame frames (0-3 FONT_TEX_02, 4-7 FONT_TEX_03)

name: Hud_ComboWatch
comment: shows the combo counter when a side's combo_hits changes and is > 1 (side 1 only in VS-type battles)

name: Combo_Show
comment: (count, side) starts a 40-frame combo counter task (count capped at 99)

name: Combo_DrawLeft
comment: (sprites, ?, frame, count) digits + HITS, slide / grow / fade by frame
type: void (int buf, int a, int frame, s16 count)

name: Combo_DrawRight
comment: side 1 version of Combo_DrawLeft
type: void (int buf, int a, int frame, s16 count)

name: Combo_TaskLeft
comment: task: Combo_DrawLeft each frame for 40 frames

name: Combo_TaskRight
comment: task: Combo_DrawRight each frame for 40 frames

name: g_HudSprites
comment: HUD sprite records 0x28: s16 texture group, index, ?, f32 x, y, texture w, h, u, v, w, h (0 HITS, 12-21 digits 0-9)

name: Fighter_AddComboHit
comment: (attacker) combo_hits + 1 per landed hit; keeps the Biggest combo record 0x0060D17C

name: Fighter_ResetCombo
comment: combo_hits = 0

name: Fighter_GetComboHits
comment: -> combo_hits
